environment: https://agynexa.si through the in-app side browser

results: Search, business area and capability are in one row. All three fields are 48px high and aligned to the same top edge.
One detail region, no catalogue sidebar or separate category button row. The result count uses Arabic digits.
Searching the approved short label, opening the standalone capability and browser Back preserve the search, area and selected capability.
The fields stack in the same order without horizontal overflow.
Switching language preserves the active area, capability and query, and shows Results: 1.
A single stack of three labelled controls precedes the details.
A direct URL selects Finance. Keyboard selection of Connections exposes its system requirements in place on the same Solutions path.
A direct Logistics URL, the open workflow and one fact column survive switching to English.

limits: The inner system requirements disclosure is document-local. The selected workflow and capability are URL-backed.
Studio verification in this release is limited to anonymous HTTP entry and indexing policy.
